label: 10x Genomics HDF5
definition: HDF5 format produced by 10x Genomics Cell Ranger storing a sparse cell-by-feature count matrix with barcodes and feature metadata for single-cell experiments.

label: AnnData Zarr
definition: Zarr-based on-disk representation of AnnData objects enabling out-of-core and distributed access to single-cell count matrices and metadata.

label: Apache Parquet
definition: Open-source columnar storage format for efficient analytical queries on large tabular datasets, widely used in bioinformatics cloud pipelines.

label: Arrow IPC
definition: Apache Arrow Inter-Process Communication (IPC) format for storing columnar tabular data in a memory-mapped layout enabling zero-copy reads, used for high-throughput data exchange between tools.

label: BEDPE
definition: Paired-end BED format representing structural variants or chromatin interactions as pairs of genomic intervals, each encoding two chromosomal loci.

label: BGEN
definition: Binary format for storing imputed or genotyped variants with probabilistic genotype dosages, used for large-scale association analysis.

label: BLOW5
definition: Binary (blocked, compressed) version of SLOW5 for Oxford Nanopore raw signal data, providing random access and smaller file sizes.

label: Cooler
definition: HDF5-based format for storing chromosome conformation capture contact matrices at one or multiple resolutions.

label: FAST5
definition: HDF5-based format produced by Oxford Nanopore sequencers for storing raw electrical signal and basecalled sequences; superseded by POD5.

label: FCS
definition: Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) binary format for storing per-event fluorescence intensity measurements from flow cytometry or mass cytometry experiments.

label: Fragments file
definition: Tab-separated file listing per-cell chromatin accessibility fragments with chromosome, position, cell barcode, and read count, used for scATAC-seq analysis.

label: GWAS-SSF
definition: GWAS Summary Statistics Format (SSF): a standardized tab-separated format for sharing GWAS summary statistics, including variant coordinates, effect alleles, effect sizes, and p-values.

label: H5AD
definition: HDF5-backed format for AnnData objects, storing a cell-by-feature matrix with metadata, embeddings, and neighborhood graphs for single-cell analysis.

label: .hic
definition: Binary format for storing genome-wide Hi-C chromatin contact matrices at multiple resolutions, with normalization vectors.

label: MEX
definition: Market Exchange Format (MEX): a three-file bundle (matrix, barcodes, features) representing a sparse cell-by-feature count matrix for single-cell sequencing experiments.

label: Modkit pileup
definition: Tab-separated format for reporting per-position base modification frequencies from aligned nanopore reads.

label: NIfTI
definition: Neuroimaging Informatics Technology Initiative (NIfTI) format for storing volumetric neuroimaging data such as MRI and fMRI, with voxel intensities and spatial orientation metadata.

label: ONNX
definition: Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) format: an open standard for representing machine learning model architectures and trained weights, enabling interoperability between frameworks and deployment runtimes.

label: Pairs
definition: Tab-separated format for recording Hi-C read-pair alignments, storing chromosome, position, strand, and pair-type for each ligation junction.

label: PLINK binary
definition: Three-file binary genotype format (.bed/.bim/.fam) used by PLINK for large-scale genome-wide association studies and population genetics.

label: POD5
definition: Oxford Nanopore's current binary format for raw electrical signal data, replacing FAST5, with efficient random access and signal compression.

label: PyTorch model
definition: PyTorch serialized format (.pt/.pth) for storing trained deep learning model weights, used to distribute models for biological sequence analysis and structure prediction.

label: SafeTensors
definition: Hugging Face SafeTensors binary format for storing neural network weight tensors with memory-mapped zero-copy access, preferred for distributing large bioinformatics foundation models.

label: SLOW5
definition: Text-based format for Oxford Nanopore raw signal data, designed as a streaming-friendly alternative to FAST5/POD5.

label: Spectral library
definition: Reference database of experimentally acquired or predicted MS/MS fragment ion spectra used by DIA-MS tools for targeted peptide quantification.

label: Visium spatial format
definition: 10x Genomics Visium output combining a gene expression count matrix with spot spatial coordinates and tissue image for spatial transcriptomics analysis.
